name: concat-bridge
description: Chrome MV3 extension that lets the Concat desktop editor use the browser's Flow and ChatGPT sessions. No dependencies; this file only tells Node that lib/ and test/ are ES modules.

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check lib/protocol.js && node --check popup.js && node --check sites/common.js && node --check sites/flow.js && node --check sites/chatgpt.js && node --check tools/make-icons.mjs
